info.name: Shopizer APIs (generated from Spring controllers)
info.description: Generated from sm-shop Spring controller annotations. Request bodies are placeholders and may need adjustment.

item.name: Sends a request to reset password (POST /api/v1/auth/customer/password)
Authenticates a customer to the application (POST /api/v1/customer/login)
Registers a customer to the application (POST /api/v1/customer/register)
Check if catalog code already exists (GET /api/v1/private/catalog/unique)
Get category hierarchy from root. Supports filtering FEATURED_CATEGORIES and VISIBLE ONLY by adding ?filter=[featured] or ?filter=[visible] or ? filter=[featured,visible (GET /api/v1/category)
Get category list for an given Category code (GET /api/v1/category/{friendlyUrl})
Check if category code already exists (GET /api/v1/private/category/unique)
Get category list for an given Category id (GET /api/v1/private/category/{id})
Move a category under another category (PUT /api/v1/private/category/{id}/move/{parent})
Sends an email contact us to store owner (POST /api/v1/contact)
Get boxes for a given MerchantStore (GET /api/v1/content/boxes)
Get box content by code for a code and a given MerchantStore (GET /api/v1/content/boxes/{code})
Get page names created for a given MerchantStore (GET /api/v1/content/pages)
Get page content by code for a given MerchantStore (GET /api/v1/content/pages/name/{name})
Get page content by code for a given MerchantStore (GET /api/v1/content/pages/{code})
Get pages summary created for a given MerchantStore. Content summary is a content bux having code summary. (GET /api/v1/content/summary)
Get page content by code for a given MerchantStore (GET /api/v1/private/content/any/{code})
Get boxes for a given MerchantStore (GET /api/v1/private/content/boxes)
Manage box content by code for a code and a given MerchantStore (GET /api/v1/private/content/boxes/{code})
Get page names created for a given MerchantStore (GET /api/v1/private/content/pages)
Get contents (page and box) for a given MerchantStore (GET /api/v1/private/contents/any)
Deletes a loged in customer profile (DELETE /api/v1/auth/customer/)
Updates a loged in customer profile (PATCH /api/v1/auth/customer/)
Updates a loged in customer address (PATCH /api/v1/auth/customer/address)
Check if store code already exists (GET /api/v1/private/store/unique)
Get store branding and marketing details (GET /api/v1/private/store/{code}/marketing)
Create or save store branding and marketing details (POST /api/v1/private/store/{code}/marketing)
Get list of stores. Returns all retailers and stores. If superadmin everything is returned, else only retailer and child stores. (GET /api/v1/private/stores)
Get list of store names. Returns all retailers and stores (GET /api/v1/private/stores/names)
Get list of store supported languages. (GET /api/v1/store/languages)
Check if store code already exists (GET /api/v1/store/unique)
Creates an optin event type definition (POST /api/v1/private/optin)
Check if product code already exists (GET /api/v1/private/product/unique)
Get a product by friendlyUrl (slug) version 2 (GET /api/v2/product/friendly/{friendlyUrl})
Get a product by friendlyUrl (slug) version 2 (GET /api/v2/product/name/{friendlyUrl})
Check if option code already exists (GET /api/v1/private/product/option/unique)
Check if option value code already exists (GET /api/v1/private/product/option/value/unique)
Get products groups for a given merchant (GET /api/v1/private/product/groups)
Delete product group by group code (DELETE /api/v1/products/group/{code})
Get images for a given product (GET /api/v1/product/{productId}/images)

exec: if (Array.isArray(inv.prices) && inv.prices.length > 0 && inv.prices[0].id != null) pm.collectionVariables.set("priceId", String(inv.prices[0].id));

item.name: Get all manufacturers for all items in a given category (GET /api/v1/category/{id}/manufacturer)
Check if manufacturer code already exists (GET /api/v1/private/manufacturer/unique)
Check if option set code already exists (GET /api/v1/private/product/property/set/unique)
Get product related items. This is used for doing cross-sell and up-sell functionality on a product details page (GET /api/v1/product/{id}/related)
Verify if product type is unique (GET /api/v1/private/product/type/unique)
Check if option set code already exists (GET /api/v2/private/product/{id}/variant/{sku}/unique)
Get all variation for all items in a given category (GET /api/v2/category/{id}/variations)
Check if option set code already exists (GET /api/v2/private/product/variation/unique)
Get product price variation based on selected product (POST /api/v2/product/{id}/variation)
Get public configuration for a given merchant store (GET /api/v1/config)
Get shipping origin for a specific merchant store (GET /api/v1/private/shipping/origin)
Get list of configured packages types for a specific merchant store (GET /api/v1/private/shipping/packages)
Get a shopping cart by authenticated customer (GET /api/v1/auth/customer/cart)
Get a shopping cart by customer id. Customer must be authenticated (GET /api/v1/auth/customer/{id}/cart)
Add product to shopping cart when no cart exists, this will create a new cart id (POST /api/v1/cart)
Get a chopping cart by code (GET /api/v1/cart/{code})
Add to an existing shopping cart or modify an item quantity (PUT /api/v1/cart/{code})
Add to an existing shopping cart or modify an item quantity (POST /api/v1/cart/{code}/multi)
Remove a product from a specific cart (DELETE /api/v1/cart/{code}/product/{sku})
Add promo / coupon to an existing cart (POST /api/v1/cart/{code}/promo/{promo})
Add product to a specific customer shopping cart (POST /api/v1/customers/{id}/cart)
Get a specific user profile by user id (GET /api/v1/private/users/{id})
